import csv, hashlib, io, json
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('products/services/catalogue-google-group-id-delivery')
fixtures = []
for name in ('consistent.csv', 'conflicting.csv'):
    raw = (base / 'fictional-inputs' / name).read_bytes()
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), newline=''))
    rows = list(reader)
    fixtures.append((reader.fieldnames, rows, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()))
left, right = fixtures
aligned = left[0] == right[0] and len(left[1]) == len(right[1])
changes = [{'csv_data_row': i, 'field': field, 'consistent': a[field], 'conflicting': b[field]} for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(left[1], right[1]), 1) for field in left[0] if a[field] != b[field]] if aligned else []
passed = aligned and len(changes) == 1 and changes[0]['field'] == 'item_group_id'
report = {'scope': 'Synthetic fixture isolation check. Merchant controls and Google ingestion are outside this execution.', 'aligned': aligned, 'data_rows': [len(left[1]), len(right[1])], 'input_sha256': {'consistent.csv': left[2], 'conflicting.csv': right[2]}, 'changes': changes, 'only_one_item_group_id_cell_changed': passed}
result = json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
(base / 'director-fixture-isolation.json').write_text(result, encoding='utf-8')
print(result, end='')
